actions.message: Great job contributing! Keep it up.

answer.explanation: Wallet is above 30% so baseline 80% applies, but average contribution is below 30% so we add extra 30% of wallet. Full wallet (38.83) is the max we can give. No affordable punishment possible. Praise Resident2 for past high contributions.

message.reasoning:
We need decide action. Wallet 38.83, below 30%? 30% of initial 100 =30, wallet 38.83 >30 so baseline 80% contribution => 0.8*38.83 =31.064. Average contribution? Compute from history: contributions totals per round: round1 total_pool 161 from others, per-agent share 40.25. Round2 total_pool 60.25. Round3 total_pool 155.31 (our contribution). Average contribution each round = total_pool /6? Round1 avg =161/6≈26.83% of endowment? That's 26.83 units. That's below 30% threshold (30% of endowment =30). So conditional cooperation says increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet. Extra 30% of wallet =0.3*38.83=11.649. Baseline 31.064+11.649=42.713, but cannot exceed wallet 38.83. So max contribution is wallet. So we can contribute full wallet 38.83. That aligns with rule: if avg below 30%, increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet, but limited by wallet. So contribute 38.83.

Punish? Check any agent contributed less than 10% for two consecutive rounds. Look at contributions: Resident1 contributed 0 both rounds1-3. That's <10% (10). Two consecutive rounds (1 and2). So punish Resident1 amount 10 (cost 3). We have enough wallet? Punish cost deducted from our wallet after contribution? Execution order: pool settlement then punishment. Our wallet after contribution will be 0 (since we contributed all). Then cannot afford punishment cost 0.3*10=3 => unaffordable, skip. So cannot punish.

We can also send private praise to any who contributed >=60% of their wallet this round. We contributed full wallet, but others: Resident2 contributed 0 rounds 1-3? round1 80, round2 60.25, round3 0. Their wallet unknown but likely less than 60%? Hard. Maybe praise Resident2? They contributed 80 in round1 (80% of 100). So send private message.

We can also broadcast norm every 5 rounds, round 3 not needed.

Thus actions: contribute full wallet, private_message Resident2.
